transcript.content: Hello, I'm glad you could make it in today. What brings you in to see me?

Ever since they changed my hours at the warehouse and brought in that new inventory system, I feel like I’m falling apart. I’ve been missing shifts and church commitments, snapping at my family. Some mornings I just sit there in my work boots wondering whether I can even face going in.
Over the past few weeks, have you been feeling down or depressed most of the day, nearly every day?
I’m not sure I’d call it depressed most of the day, every day. I just know I’ve been having a hard time dealing with everything.
Are you finding yourself worrying excessively about many different areas of your life, or is your stress mainly focused on the situation at work?

It’s mainly the work situation. Since the hours changed and they brought in that new system, I just can’t seem to handle it. It’s spilling over into everything—missing shifts and church, snapping at my family—but it all starts with thinking about going into that warehouse.
